definitions.gloss: outside air, outdoor air, outdoor temperature
definitions.explanation: The air or atmospheric conditions outside a building or enclosed space. Used when discussing ventilation, temperature differences, or exposure to the outdoors.

examples.japanese: {外気|がいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れる→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧。
{外気|がいき}{温|おん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{氷点下|ひょうてんか}→氷点下：07669_hyoutenka⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: The outdoor temperature dropped below freezing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧{外気|がいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れ{替|か}わった→入れ替わる：11628_irekawaru⟧。
examples.english: When I opened the window and let in the outside air, the air in the room was completely refreshed.

notes:
{外気|がいき} refers to the air outside a building or enclosed space. Most commonly used when discussing temperature or ventilation.

FORMS:
⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside) + ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (air, atmosphere).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外気|がいき}{温|おん}: outdoor temperature (a very common compound)
- {外気|がいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れる→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧: to take in outside air
- {外気|がいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧: to be exposed to outside air
- {外気|がいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to get some fresh air
- {外気|がいき}⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧: intake of outside air (HVAC term)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外気|がいき}: outside air (technical/formal)
- ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧: outside air (everyday expression)
- ⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧: indoor air
{外気|がいき} appears frequently in weather forecasts ({外気|がいき}{温|おん}), health advice, and building/ventilation contexts.
